item.title: Q2 Billings Area Weather: Thursday felt like May; Friday will be quite mild, too
item.description: Numerous record highs were broken in Montana & Wyoming on Thursday with a combination of sunshine, gusty wind and high pressure. Although Friday won't be as windy or warm, it will still be very mild.

item.title: Billings administrators outline rules for student walkouts after ICE protest
item.description: As protests continue across the country over immigration enforcement, tensions are rising among both adults and students, leading to walkouts at schools nationwide, including in Billings.

item.title: Finding 'green grass,' Bobby Kennedy energized to lead Montana as new coach
item.description: The excitement rolls on at the University of Montana, and on Thursday afternoon Bobby Kennedy was officially introduced as the 38th head football coach of the Montana Grizzlies.
